title: Zscaler Identity Protection Licensing and Fair Use

blocks.text: Zscaler Identity Protection is a Software as a Service (SaaS) product that is licensed according to the number of user identities purchased for the subscription term in an order. The number of user identities is counted as the total number of user identities processed and stored in Identity Protection.

For Identity Protection, user identity means each unique individual whose identity is provisioned, managed, or otherwise represented within the Identity Protection SaaS application, regardless of whether such individual directly accesses or logs into the Identity Protection SaaS application.

Ensure that you order the correct number of user identities. If you require additional user identities, contact Zscaler Sales or your Channel Partner. Zscaler periodically reviews the number of user identities to ensure license compliance.
The usage of Identity Protection is expected to be in accordance with the Acceptable Use Policy. The Fair Use Policy for Identity Protection is:

blocks.item: The average data processing (uncompressed) is expected to be no more than 3MB per user identity on a daily basis.
The average number of daily queries per account is expected to be no more than 4K queries per day.

blocks.text: If your usage exceeds the acceptable amount, contact Zscaler Sales or your Channel Partner to discuss available options.
